featuresHint: A system administrator switches features on and off.
loginLinkFor: One-time sign-in link for {{who}} (valid for 3 days). Send it to them; after signing in they set up a passkey or password, or link a Google or Microsoft account.

git.title: Git
git.intro: The project folder can be a git repository: its files and the shared part of .osiris/ (knowledge, memory, skills, rules, assistants) are versioned; conversations, keys and personal data never leave the project. For a private repository add the key GIT_TOKEN (Keys and passwords) with the repository's host allowed.
git.confirmConnect: Connect the project? The branch's files replace the project's files of the same name.
